comment: Read at commit 762045d, the tip of master. Two commits carry 2.0.0, 0c31f73 and 9c67656, and two later ones touch nothing that ships. The installed plugin.json is byte-identical to the one at 9c67656, which fills in the three empty URLs and the module description that 0c31f73 left as three dots, so the build is at or after that commit; the only commit after it, 762045d, changes the Makefile's default RACK_DIR from a Windows path to the relative one, which cannot change the build. No source file has been touched since 0c31f73, so there is one behaviour to describe either way. Panel lettering is TOGGLE, HOLD over the button, CONST over the trimpot, OUT on the output jack, and a plain upward triangle over each of the two input jacks - so neither input carries a name and both lines lead with what the jack does. Widget order follows enum order and the panel runs straight down in that order. Each configInput and configOutput is called once with its own enum. No dead controls: both parameters and both inputs are read in process(). One thing the maker's README does not say. It calls the trigger input a trigger without a figure, and the code rescales 0.1 to 2.0 onto the SchmittTrigger's default 0 to 1 window, so the threshold is 2V rather than Rack's usual 1V and a 1V trigger will not fire it. A dsp::SchmittTrigger member named holdSchmitt is declared at line 43 and never used; it is not a control and gets no line. The LOGO_LIGHT is set to full brightness once in the constructor and is decoration. The module has no menu of its own; the two panel SVGs are Rack's own light and dark theming rather than a setting.
